heuristics.statement: For the fixed selected BLAKE3-r3 and f_S(x)=F(LE32(S)||LE32(x)), independent uniform 256-bit salt and initial state produce an orbit with positive tail and tail-plus-cycle length at most2^128 with probability at least0.39.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the64-byte injected message family, full256-bit iterates, one bounded Floyd attempt with predecessor recovery.
heuristics.extrapolation: Transfer the random-mapping birthday/tail calculation and finite12/16-bit projected exact-target evidence to the fixed full256-bit salt family. This does not follow from coin independence, and no full-scale execution is claimed.
heuristics.limitations: Projected mask collisions are not full collisions. Seed-derived finite trials do not establish iid or independent attack coins;12/16-to256-bit extrapolation is unproved. Random-map analysis is conditional and cannot establish this fixed-target premise.
